Commentary.Commentary: So, India have a target of 243 set in front of them. It won't be easy by any means as the pitch will be a tricky one to play on. If the Kiwi bowlers can be patient and adapt to the conditions, we could be in for an entertaining run chase. Join us in a short while for that.

The Black Caps will be very disappointed with the fact that they couldn't finish well. After losing Martin Guptill early, Williamson and Latham took the reins and knocked the ball around very well. They stitched a 120-run stand at a brisk rate with the skipper scoring a ton. But after that partnership was broken, nobody from the middle order really capitalized on the platform set for them.

Once the Indian bowlers broke the Latham-Williamson partnership, they clawed their way back from there and did extremely well to restrict New Zealand under 250. Amit Mishra picked up 3 wickets but Bumrah really impressed with the final spell in the death. He too scalped 3 heads and kept the runs tight from his end. Both of them were supported well by their fellow bowlers and it was a good all-round performance.

A terrific comeback from the Men in Blue towards the end of the innings! Going into the dressing room, they will be very happy with how they've finished with the ball. They got off to a great start, but were then taken for runs in the middle overs and it looked like the game would be taken away from them.
Fine finish from India! Fuller outside off, Boult makes room and taps it to covers and takes a single to end their innings. NEW ZEALAND FINISH ON 242/9!
FOUR! That will do! Fuller outside off, Boult throws his bat at it and gets it down to third man fence off the edge.
This one is on the stumps, Boult plays it back to the bowler.

Edged! Good length outside off, Boult edges it behind the wicket but the ball does not carry to Dhoni. Being awake to chance of a run stolen, Dhoni runs down to the keeper's end but Boult was back in.
Trent Boult is the last man in.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Another one on the stumps from Bumrah, a cutter, Henry fails to pick it, looks to hit it out of Delhi but connects thin air and hears the death rattle. New Zealand will rue not making most of a good platform today.
Fuller on middle, Henry makes room and hits it back towards the bowler who mimes the throw.
Another slower one outside off, Santner looks to attack but is beaten all ends up.
Cutter outside off, Santner looks to flay it through but misses.
Dug in short on middle, Henry top edges his pull towards mid-wicket for a single.
A TV replay has just caught a girl sleeping in the crowd. Well one can say about New Zealand too in the game, they have slept off after a good start today.
Fuller outside off, Santner drives it through mid off for a single.
Full toss on middle, heaved to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller outside off, slapped down the ground for a single by Santner.
Spears in a yorker on middle and leg, Henry is beaten all ends up.
EDGED! Fuller on middle, Santner comes down and has a go at it but gets it down to third man but off the edge. A run taken.
Fuller outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Fuller outside leg, Santner drives it hard towards mid on. Pandya stops the ball but cannot stop the single and returns a strong throw back to the bowler.
Similar cutter outside off, Henry this time cuts it towards point where Pandey dives to stop the ball to his right. A single taken.
Starts off with a slower one outside off, Henry waits for it and ends up only waiting to play his shot as he is beaten.
On a length on middle, Henry mistimes his slap down the ground for a single.
This one is played through wide mid on for a run by Santner.
On a length outside off, Henry takes a single towards mid-wicket off the inner half of the bat.
Back of a length on middle, Henry backs away a touch and defends it.
Santner taps it towards covers and looks for a quick single. Axar fields it from mid off and looks to run out Santner at non-striker's end but misses.
Bowls it outside off, played to point by Santner.
Another yorker on middle, kept out by Henry. End of a really good over from Bumrah.

OUT! Timber! New Zealand have lost their way! Full and into the stumps, Southee is late and is beaten for pace as the ball cannons into the stumps. India have comeback really strongly in the game. MATT HENRY is the new man in.
Spears in a yorker on middle and leg, Southee digs it out with an inside edge towards Dhoni who dives to his left to stop that one.
Bowls a low full toss outside off, Santner hits it hard to sweeper cover for a single.
Another cutter outside off, Santner looks to play at it but is beaten.
Tim Southee is the next batsman in.

OUT! GOOD CATCH! Starts off with a cutter on middle, Devcich gets across to paddle it but does not connect well. The ball lobs towards short fine leg. Axar takes a couple of paces back at short fine, stretches out his right hand and takes a good leaping catch. That was well held by Axar. New Zealand continue to lose wickets in a flurry here.
Bumrah called back on for a bowl. Dhoni has a word with him about the field.
This one is lofted over mid off for a single by Devcich.

NOT OUT! Flatter on middle, Devcich sweeps it through square leg off his crease. The throw comes in at the striker's end. Dhoni takes the bails off and appeals since Devcich was a bit lazy to drag his bat through on the second run. Replays show that he was just in. He seems to be struggling with his hamstring too.
A run out appeal against Devcich is referred upstairs.
Spots the batsman coming down, fires it full on middle, Devcich clips it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Devcich had to dive to get back in his crease.
This one comes in with the spin, played through cover-point for a single.
Tossed up outside off, pushed to covers by Santner.
Flatter outside off, Devcich reverse sweeps it through backward point for a single.
Santner looks to flay this one through covers but fails to put bat to ball.
Santner pushes this one to covers.
Shorter outside off, played towards backward point off his crease for a single.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! A flatter one outside off, Ronchi goes back to cut it through but fails to connect cleanly. The ball takes the outside edge and this time Dhoni takes it cleanly and celebrates the wicket. Two quick wickets for India. Anton Devcich is the new man in.
Fuller outside off, driven to covers but not for any runs.
Floated outside off, driven nicely through covers for a single.
Shorter on middle, Ronchi works it down to long on for a couple of runs.
Ronchi defends this one from his crease.
MS and Virat have a chat about the way to go ahead.
Mitchell Santner is the new man in.

OUT! Mishra strikes again! Floated on middle, Williamson looks to go big but does not time it well. The ball skies down towards long off where Rahane takes it calmly. A timely wicket for India but will New Zealand mind this one? Williamson was struggling to get the big shots in there. He walks off to a loud applause.
Too full on off, played down to long on for a single by Ronchi.
This one is bowled the pads, swept to deep fine leg for a single.
Flatter on middle, comes down and clips it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Fuller outside off, Williamson slinks down and lofts it to the left of the bowler. A single taken.
Fuller on middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a run.
Played back to the bowler by Ronchi.
Short again outside off, punched towards covers off the crease.
Flatter on the pads, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Bowls it short outside off, punched off the back foot through covers for a single.

Over the wicket to Ronchi, flatter and turning away from outside off, it's run down to third man and the batsmen set off for a quick run. A throw is fired in at the striker's end. Dhoni has great presence of mind to hit the stumps as he throws the ball between his feet with his back to the stumps. A single is completed though.

OUT! MISHRA GETS HIS MAN! After having the decision not going his way just a few deliveries ago, he's now struck. Continues from around the wicket and bowls a straighter one around off, it's drifting in as Anderson looks to play this across the line. Misses and is caught on the pads. There are loud appeals for a leg before and this time the umpire gives it out. Anderson has to make the long walk back and it will be Luke Ronchi who replaces him out in the middle.
Williamson gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it down to long on for one run.
Low full toss around off, Anderson off the toe end of the bat drives it down to long on for a single.
Straighter one outside off, it's worked to short third man off the back foot.

ROARING LBW APPEAL! Mishra comes from around the wicket and tosses it up on around off, Anderson kneels down to sweep this away but is rapped on the front pad. Mishra turns around and pleads for a leg before but for some reason, the umpire turns it down. No idea why, that looked plumb.
Powerplay three in play now. India can have an extra fielder outside the circle now.
Mishra comes back on.
Length ball around off, Anderson goes for the big heave but ends up getting an inside edge onto this pads. Takes a single as the ball rolls away.
Umesh spears in a full ball and attacks the stumps, it's played towards mid on.

Terrific stuff from Rahane! Length ball aiming the top of off stump, Williamson brings his beautiful wrists into play and whips it towards mid-wicket. Rahane is the man there and he dives full stretch to his right to stop the ball from going past him. Even has a shy at the bowler's end too. A single is taken.
Comes around the wicket to the left-hander, angles in a length ball from around off, Corey Anderson taps it on the off side for a run. 200 comes up for New Zealand with that.
Field change now. Mid off drops back but a bit wide.
Good length ball outside off, Kane taps it to the off side and takes a brisk single.
Yadav comes steaming in and fires in a full ball on the stumps, Williamson drives it towards mid on but can't get past the diving fielder there.
Umesh back on for a bowl.
Full toss outside off, CA hits it straight to the man at covers.
On middle and leg, it's worked to the on side for a quick run.
Off-cutter from Jasprit, it's going away around off, tapped away to the off side for a single.
Almost a yorker, aiming the base of off stump, Corey squeezes it out towards mid-wicket and scurries to the other end for a double.
Slower one from Bumrah, pitches it on a fuller length on middle and leg, Anderson clears his front leg and keeps it out back down the track.
Fullish in length and angling in on the pads, it's clipped to deep square leg for a single.
Bumrah is back into the attack.
Pandya angles in a length ball from outside off, Williamson tucks it towards mid-wicket and hobbles to the other end to complete a single.
Just back of a length around off, defended from within the crease.

Slower one from Hardik Pandya, it's coming in from around off, Williamson looks to flick but misses and is rapped on the pads. No appeal for a leg before though. Pandya charges to the ball seeing Kane out of his crease and has a shy but misses.
Fuller length ball on off stump, tapped away on the off side for nothing.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Williamson stands his ground and lofts it back over mid on to send it across the fence. Stunning shot.
Back of a length and angling in from outside off, KW wrists it towards mid on. Dot ball.
Over the wicket now to Kane Williamson, it's short and wide outside off, the Kiwi skipper punches it through to deep cover and takes a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Looped up leg breaker on middle and off, it's worked to mid-wicket for nothing.
Short and turning away around off, it's punched down to long on for a single.
Turning in on middle and leg, it's clipped to the on side for a single.
FOUR! From around the wicket, Mishra tosses it up outside off, Anderson comes forward, leans across and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket to send it across the ropes. Terrific shot.
8th ODI hundred for Kane Williamson!

TON! Played, Kane! Fuller outside off, Kane comes forward and drives it through covers for a couple and that brings up his ton. He takes off his helmet and raises his bat to acknowledge the applause but also calls for the physio. He is getting some medical help here.
Even the right arm is hurting Kane now.
Bowls a full toss outside off, Williamson drives it towards covers but cannot take the single. The crowd is getting involved too.
Fuller outside off, at 141 kph, Williamson clips it towards mid-wicket.
On a length on middle and leg, tucked to mid-wicket for a single by Corey. Brings Williamson on strike, who is on 99!
Goes round the wicket.
Angled on a length outside off, worked through square leg for a single.
Another delay, this time Kane Williamson seems to have hurt his left hand. The physio is out in the middle attending his left forearm.
Good length on off, Williamson defends it towards mid-wicket off his crease.
Bumrah back on.
Short and on middle and off, waits for it to turn and then punches it down to long on for one run to end the over.
Floated well around the off stump, Kane prods forward and pushes it to the cover region.
Full and looped up on the stumps, it's swept through square leg for one.
Corey Anderson defends this one off his back foot.
Gets down and sweeps it through backward square leg once more. There's a fielder out in the deep this time, though. Will get only a single.
FOUR! Played that so effortlessly. Too straight and too full from Amit Mishra, Williamson kneels down and sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Amit Mishra comes back on.

FOUR! In the air... but that's gone through! Fullish in length outside off, it stopped a bit off the track. Anderson is a bit early into the shot as a result and the balls lobs towards Kohli at mid off. It's just wide of him though and the ball then races away to the fence.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Good length ball aiming the top of off stump, Corey stays deep in his crease and keeps it out comfortably.
Good length delivery angling in from outside off, Anderson pushes this in front of covers. Won't get any run for it.
Full and outside off, Corey stands tall and drives it back down towards mid off for nothing.
From around the wicket, Umesh Yadav fires in a fuller ball outside off, Anderson blocks it out with a solid bat.
Drinks break! New Zealand will be the most happy seeing that.
Short and wide outside off, Corey Anderson rocks back and cuts it to deep backward point for an easy single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Shorter one around off, Corey goes back and punches it on the off side for a single.
It's nudged towards backward square leg for an easy single.
From around the wicket and tosses it up outside off, Anderson drives it towards mid off for a run.
Coming in on the pads, it's flicked through to deep square leg for a single.
Kedar Jadhav comes back into the attack.
Pitches it up a bit and outside off, Umesh Yadav wants Anderson to drive this away from his body. The southpaw doesn't bother with it though.
Back of a length outside off, defended solidly.
Lovely from Umesh Yadav! It's a length ball which comes in with the angle, just moved away a touch off the seam as Anderson fails to put bat on ball.
Umesh with another length delivery, Anderson has nothing to do with that one as he watches the ball go past him and into the keeper's gloves.
Comes from around the wicket to the left-hander, it's on a length and outside off, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Full and angling in on the pads, it's flicked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Umesh Yadav is back on.
Corey Anderson is the new man in.

OUT! MISHRA STRIKES! It's the straighter one once more, full and outside off, Ross Taylor kneels down to this one and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket. Doesn't get the distance on it though and it's straight into the hands of Rohit Sharma in the deep. Another wicket down for New Zealand.
On middle and leg, it's tapped softly to the on side and a quick single is taken.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and flat once more, outside off, this time Taylor connects and hits it towards mid-wicket. Pandey is the man there and it goes right through his legs. A single is taken.
Full and flat outside off, turning away, Taylor goes for the big slog sweep but misses as the ball goes under his bat.
Flatter way outside off, Taylor goes after it but misses. That could have been called a wide.
Tucked through square leg for a single to keep the strike.

FOUR! Poor effort, Rahane! Fuller outside off, Taylor squeezes it past a diving Rahane at point for a boundary. Taylor waited well for the slower one. That went through Rahane who dived going to his left. Hardik is not happy.
Length ball outside off, Taylor gets across and looks to paddle it down to fine leg but is hit on the pads.
On a length outside off, Taylor mistimes his pull through mid-wicket for a couple.
Dabbed down to third man for a single.

Angled on a length on off, played towards mid on by Taylor. He calls Williamson through for a single. Pandey from mid on, collects and looks to run Taylor out but fails to stop the ball. Even Hardik dived to his right to stop that one in his followthrough. Good intent from India. The single is completed.
Too full on off, driven down to long off for a run to retain the strike.
A touch short on middle, punched down to long on for a single.
Fuller outside off, Taylor at first looks to slog sweep but recovers in time to drive it wide of mid off for a run.
Tossed up on middle, Taylor looks to defend but is hit on his pads. No appeal from the bowler though.
Too full on the stumps, Williamson sweeps it to square leg off the inner half of the bat for a single.
Floated on middle, worked towards the on side.
Amit Mishra back on.
Played towards mid-wicket by Taylor.
Smart from the umpire to send back the substitute, Sodhi who had come on with drinks. New Zealand have had far too many of those already.
Taylor gets in line and defends it.

NOT OUT! On a length outside off, Taylor dabs it to short third man. Rahane scores a direct hit at the striker's end as Taylor is sent back in time by Williamson. The appeal is referred upstairs. The replays show that Taylor was well in.
Third umpire referred for a run out appeal.
Angled on a length on off, Ross comes across and looks to clip but fails to put bat on ball. The bowler appeals but the umpire says no.
Williamson dabs this one towards short third man for a quick single.
FOUR! Edged! Shorter length ball on middle, Williamson gets across and hooks it down to the fine leg fence. That came off the top edge.
Yet another break for Ross Taylor, he gets a drink along with a change of gloves.
Plays this one back down the wicket, the bowler stops the ball in his followthrough.
Pushed towards covers off his crease.
Shorter outside off, cut hard but to the fielder.
A touch short on off, Williamson punches it to long on for a single.
Fuller outside off, driven through mid off for a single by Taylor.
Floated outside off, cut to point by Taylor.
Length ball outside off, Williamson gets across and taps it towards mid-wicket.
Shorter on the body, Taylor works it to the left of Dhoni who goes across to stop but cannot prevent a single.
Fuller outside off, pushed to covers by Taylor.
Short outside off, Taylor looks to cut it through but gets a bottom edge past his stumps. He has struggled to time the ball today.
FOUR! HEAVED! Fuller outside off, Taylor comes down a touch and heaves it to the right of mid on for a boundary.
Begins with a length ball outside off, Taylor dabs it towards short third man but not for any run.
On middle and leg, swept to backward square for a couple of runs.
Williamson keeps this one out.
Shorter on off, Taylor punches it down to long on for a single.
Fuller outside off, Taylor comes down and pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller on off, played back to the bowler.
Shorter on middle, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter length outside off, Taylor looks to flay it through but is beaten.
Bowls the yorker again on the stumps, kept out by Taylor.
Fuller outside off, driven towards mid off. Virat goes to his left, fields the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. A single completed.
This one is on a length on off, Williamson defends it back.
Shorter in length outside off, left alone by Williamson.

Loud appeal for LBW! Bumrah spears in a yorker on the stumps, Kane is late to get his bat down in time. The ball raps him on the pads as he falls over. The bowler puts up an appeal but the umpire is not interested and rightly so. That was sliding down leg.
Another unofficial drinks break for the Kiwis.
Loopy on off, Taylor comes down to work it through but ends up mistiming it back to the bowler.
Outside off, Taylor pushes it to covers.
Flatter outside off, played back to the bowler.
Played through covers for a run.
Taylor pushes this one through point for a single.
Shorter on middle, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Just an over for Kedar, Axar returns for a bowl.
A touch short outside off, Taylor dabs it towards backward point.
On a length on off, played back down the wicket by Taylor.
EDGED! A touch short outside off, Taylor throws his bat at it and gets a bottom edge back towards the keeper who goes to his left to stop that one.
Slanted on the pads, Taylor clips it through square leg for a couple of runs to get off the mark.
On a good length outside off, Williamson works it behind square on the leg side for a single. Pandya fields and returns a throw at the striker's end.
On a length outside off, Williamson defends it back down the wicket.
Bumrah back for a spell.
Taylor plays it off the back foot towards mid on but the bowler goes to his right and stops it himself. End of a good over for India.
Action! Flatter on the stumps, Ross comes down and plays it back down the wicket. Kedar fires the throw back after collecting it in his follow through.
Floated on off, Ross plays a nervous forward defensive shot.
Ross Taylor walks in to bat.

OUT! The change in bowling works! Flatter outside off, comes in with the angle, Latham goes back to work it through the on side but is rapped on the pads. Kedar puts in a loud appeal, the umpire raises his finger. That is a vital wicket for India and once again, the golden arm of Kedar works.
Comes forward and turns this one through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! TOO EASY! Starts off with a short one on middle, keeps a touch low but Williamson picks it early and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Kedar Jadhav called on for a bowl here.
Skidding off the deck and on middle and leg, Latham has to hurriedly bring his bat down to keep it out. Does so well in time and plays it towards mid-wicket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Williamson gets low and sweeps it through backward square leg very well. The ball seems destined for the boundary but Hardik Pandya intervenes. Puts in a dive at full length and makes a brilliant save. Saves a vital run for his side as he keeps the batsmen to three.
Slightly shorter in length once more, defended off the back foot to the on side.
FOUR! Oh, that's a wonderful shot. Axar Patel floats it up on off stump, Williamson goes inside out to this one and lofts it over the cover region for a boundary.

DROPPED! Usually MS Dhoni takes 'em. Despite that being a tough chance, you'd always back him to take it. Not today, though. Flat and shortish on off, Williamson backs away and looks to cut it away. Ends up edging it and it goes right back. Within seconds, it's in and out of Dhoni's gloves. Chance goes begging.
FOUR! Excellent use of the feet here. Steps out to this loopy ball from around the wicket and drives it ever so well through the covers for a boundary.
Lots of flight on this from Amit Mishra, seeing this Williamson gets down the track and drives it down to long on for one. Good batting, this.
Another flat ball, it's swept to the on side for a single.
Mishra bowls a flat one, Latham wanted to come ahead to play this but seeing the flat trajectory, did well to stay back and dab it towards point.
Tom Latham has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Loopy googly on middle and leg, Tom Latham looks to flick it through square leg but ends up getting a leading edge towards mid-wicket. Closed the face a little too early.
Full and on the stumps, driven down towards mid on for a single.
Another shorter delivery outside off, punched off the back foot on the off side.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Floats this one up outside off, it's pushed to covers for nothing.
Short and outside off, cut away for no run.
Axar bowls it slower through the air and keeps it on a shorter length, Latham goes back and punches it down to long on for one run. The 100-run stand comes up as well.
Latham punches this to the left of a diving Amit Mishra and picks up a run. End of another good over for New Zealand.
Flatter one outside off, on a shorter length, it's punched in front of cover.
Uses his feet once again here. Gets to the pitch of the ball and eases it down to long on for a single.
Pitched just outside off, Tom dabs this in front of cover-point and takes a quick run.
SIX! He positions himself well and early and puts it away. Gets low to this floated delivery and sweeps it over the deep backward square boundary for a maximum. Beautifully hit, that.
Flatter delivery outside off, Tom punches it on the off side with soft hands.
Official drinks break!

Full once more, Latham gets a top edge as he kneels down to sweep it. Gets a top edge as the ball lobs towards backward square leg. Rahane is the man in the deep and he comes running in to try and take it. Falls well short of him though as the batsmen take a single.

Latham gets low to this fullish delivery and connects the sweep through backward square leg. It seems the ball will run away to the boundary but Rahane out in the deep does well to keep it from the ropes with a good diving effort. Keeps the batsmen down to two.
Flat and on the stumps, KW punches it down to long on for a single.
ANOTHER LBW APPEAL! Flatter and drifting in on middle and leg, Kane Williamson is rapped on the pads as he attempts to flick it away. The appeal is turned down as the ball was going down leg.
Flat and straight on middle stump, Williamson stays deep in his crease and keeps it out.
Flat and on leg stump, Tom clips it to the square leg region for a run.
Full outside off, driven to mid off to end the over.
Floated by Amit Mishra, pitches it full around off as Williamson comes forward to block.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
New Zealand have suddenly upped the ante here, hitting plenty of boundaries in the last few overs. MS Dhoni comes down to have a chat with Amit Mishra.
FOUR! Makes great use of his feet this time. Skips out, takes it on the full and flicks it through mid-wicket for another boundary. The pressure is on Mishra already.
Full on the stumps, blocked.
26th ODI fifty for Kane Williamson!

FOUR! Welcomes the leggie with a boundary. It's full and flat on middle and leg, Williamson gets low to this one and sweeps it across the fine leg fence. Brings up his half century with that and it's been a superb knock so far.
AMIT MISHRA comes on for a bowl.
FOUR! Lovely shot by the southpaw. Fullish in length and angled across, Latham just crunches this through the cover region and sends it all the way.

DROPPED! This one should have been taken though. Bumrah bowls it full and outside off, Williamson drives this one the up and ends up lobbing it towards mid off. Hardik Pandya is the man there and he runs to his left. Dives low and tries to take it but fails to keep a hold of it. A single is taken.
Outside off, it's kept out solidly off the back foot.
Good length ball outside off, Kane cuts it to point. Won't get any run for it though.

HUGE LBW APPEAL! But it's turned down and rightly so. Good length delivery angling in sharply on leg, Williamson looks to flick it away but misses and is rapped on the pads. There's a huge appeal for a leg before but the umpire isn't interested as it was sliding down leg.
Fullish outside off, it's driven to covers for a single.
Turning in from outside off, Tom Latham gets back and turns it to the on side for a run. 16 runs have come off it and this has been a great over for New Zealand.
The Kiwi skipper punches this one down to long off and takes a single.

FOUR! He's turning it on here. Showing his strengths as he plays the spinners brilliantly. It's flatter around off, Kane Williamson goes back and plays this very late. Cuts it past short third man and sends it all the way, beating the chasing fielder with ease.

SIX! Wonderful from Kane Williamson, just oozes class every time he plays. Axar Patel tosses it up outside off, Williamson makes good use of his feet, gets to the pitch of the delivery and launches it over the wide long on fence for a biggie.
Turning away from around off, played to point for nothing.
FOUR! It's poor and Williamson is on to this in a flash. Rocks back quickly to this flat and short delivery and pulls it through the gap in the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Fullish in length and just around off, Tom prods forward and keeps it out.
Maintains it on a length once more, it's just outside off, Kane Williamson opens the face of the blade and guides it down to third man for a single.
Arrowed in full and well outside off, some width on offer here for Kane Williamson. He drives it a bit square straight to the man at point.
Good length delivery pitched outside off, Williamson stays back and dabs it to gully.
On a good length and attacking the stumps once more, Latham works this wide of mid on and takes a brisk single.
Fuller in length and attacking the stumps, Latham pushes this back down towards mid off.
Change of ends for Bumrah!
Williamson comes down and clips this one through mid-wicket for a couple. That went off the inside half of the bat.
The mid on fielder drops back.
Another short one on middle, played to mid on off the back foot by Williamson.
Quicker one on middle, Williamson plays it back down the wicket.
Fuller outside off, Williamson comes forward and keeps it out.
Shorter on off, played back to the bowler by Kane.
Floated outside off, Latham works it through mid-wicket for a single.
AXAR PATEL comes into the attack.
50-run stand up between Williamson and Latham!
In the gap! Williamson guides it down to third man for a couple of runs. That was a nicely placed.
Williamson drives this one nicely towards mid off.
FOUR! EDGED! On a length outside off, Williamson throws his bat at it and gets an outside edge. The ball flies past Dhoni into the third man fence. Dhoni was late to react to the chance.
A touch short outside off, Williamson arches back and taps it towards gully off his crease.
On a length outside off, Williamson looks to play at it from his crease but is beaten.
Good stop! Good length outside off, Latham stands tall and crunches it towards cover-point where Axar dives to his right and saves a certain boundary. Just a run taken.
Another drinks break for the Kiwis.
This one is played through mid on by Kane off his crease.
This one is on a length outside off, keeps very low, Williamson looks to play from his crease but is beaten.
FOUR! JUST WIDE! A touch short outside off, Williamson picks it early and pulls it wide of the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
Back of a length outside off, Williamson mistimes his punch towards mid on.
This one is punched through the off side.
Back of a length outside off, Williamson plays it back down the wicket.
JASPRIT BUMRAH comes on for a bowl.
Another one going across the batsman, Latham lets it go through.
Angled on a length outside off, left alone by Latham.
Good length on off, played back to the bowler.
Angled on a length on off, played back to the bowler.
Fullish outside off, played towards covers by Williamson. Kohli goes to his left and stops a certain boundary. A single taken.
FOUR! Poor ball! This one is also bowled on the pads and this time Williamson clips it down to the fine leg fence.
FOUR! DEFT! Angling on the pads, on a length, Latham nudges it down to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Fuller outside off, left alone by Latham.
A touch short outside off, Latham defends it back.
FOUR! NEAT! Fuller outside off, Latham gets in line and drives it nicely through extra cover for a boundary. That was sweetly timed.
On a length on off, Latham defends it.

DROPPED! Fuller on off, Latham drives it on the up back to the bowler. Umesh sticks his left hand out but cannot hold onto it. Tough chance but maybe he could have done a bit better there. The umpire gets a bit scared and has asked for the hand shield to protect himself. That is a tough return chance dropped, even the umpire was taking evasive action on that one.
WIDE! Another one very wide outside off, Latham lets it go. A wide is signaled.
An unofficial drinks break for New Zealand! Are the conditions are beginning to take a toll already?
Pitched up outside off, Williamson defends it towards mid off.
On a length outside off, Kane looks to work it through mid on with his wrists but finds the fielder.
Slanted on a length on off, defended back down the wicket.
FOUR! In the gap! Full again outside off, Williamson reaches out for it and times it just enough and wide of the mid off fielder for a boundary through extra cover.
Angled on a length on off, Kane clips it towards mid-wicket.
WIDE! Fuller but very, very wide outside off. Kane still looks to go after it and is beaten. The umpire signals the wide. You can see the pressure is getting to the Kiwi skipper.
On a length outside off, Williamson dabs it towards the slip region.
FOUR! Nicely controlled! short outside off, Latham gets on top of that one and pulls it nicely to the left of mid on for a boundary. That was superbly controlled.
Goes round the wicket to Latham, bowls it outside off, on a fuller length, Latham defends it towards mid on off the inside half of the bat.
Fuller in length on off, turned through mid-wicket for a single. Good stop from Kedar but cannot prevent the single.
Similar length on off, Williamson defends it off the crease.
Fuller again outside off, Williamson defends it getting in line of that one.
Fuller outside off, Williamson plays his trademark dab with soft hands towards the slip region.
Similar length on the stumps, played back to the bowler.
Quick single! Angled in on a length again, Kane plays it to the right of mid on and calls Latham through for a single. There is a shy at the non-striker's end but no harm done.
On a length outside off, Williamson defends it from his crease.
Slants one on a length but on the pads, Latham clips it to Bumrah at square leg for a single.
On a length outside off, Latham comes a touch down and defends it back down the wicket.
Dug in short outside off, Latham lets it go through. Expected one that.
A slip and a gully in place for Pandya. There is a third man in place, with two fielders panning the point region. So the plan seems to be bowling wide of Latham, on a shorter length.
Bowls it outside off, Williamson defends it back down the wicket.
On a length on off, tucked towards the mid-wicket region.
There is a mid-wicket in place already, that is a bit square though.
Pitched up outside off, Williamson drives it on the up towards mid off.
FOUR! SWEET! Fuller on middle, Williamson gets across a touch and clips it nicely through mid-wicket for a boundary. Umesh was trying for the in-swinger but did not get it to swing this time.
WIDE! Drifts this one down the leg side, Williamson fails to clip it. The umpire signals the wide.
Edged! Fuller again on the stumps, Latham gets it down to fine leg off the inside edge for a single.
Slanted on a fuller length outside off, left alone by Latham.
Fuller and angling in on off, Williamson keeps it out towards the leg side, Hardik goes towards his right and stops the ball.
This one is again angled on a length on off, comes in, Williamson tucks it towards mid-wicket.
BEATEN! Hurls in a length ball outside off, Williamson follows the ball away from his body and is beaten.
Angled on a length outside off, Williamson defends it off his crease.
Slanted on a length, coming in, Williamson looks to play at first but then withdraws in time.
Back of a length outside off, Williamson tucks it to deep square leg for a couple.
Hardik Pandya gets another go with the new ball.
FOUR! Latham off the mark in style! Fuller outside off, Latham gets nicely forward and drives it through covers for a boundary. End of a good over for India.
This one is on a length again outside off, Williamson guides it down to third man for a single to get off the mark.
SWING! Fuller outside off, Williamson looks to drive from his crease but is beaten.
Fuller on middle, shapes in a touch, Williamson clips it towards mid-wicket.
Kane Williamson walks in at No.3.

OUT! TIMBER! Angles it on a good length on middle and off, comes in with the angle, Guptill looks to defend from his crease but is beaten by the late movement away and is bowled. Guptill's horrible tour continues. New Zealand in early trouble. Perfect start for India here!
Begins with a good length delivery outside off, Guptill opens the face of the bat and guides it towards point.
Game time! The Indian team is in a huddle. The two New Zealand openers in TOM LATHAM and MARTIN GUPTILL are out to bat. India begin with UMESH YADAV!
The players are heading out for the national anthems.
New Zealand XI - Martin Guptill, Tom Latham, Kane Williamson(c), Ross Taylor, Anton Devcich, Corey Anderson, Luke Ronchi(wk), Mitchell Santner, Tim Southee, Matt Henry, Trent Boult.
India XI - Rohit Sharma, Ajinkya Rahane, Virat Kohli, Manish Pandey, MS Dhoni(wk/c), Kedar Jadhav, Hardik Pandya, Axar Patel, Amit Mishra, Umesh Yadav, Jasprit Bumrah.
Kane Williamson reads the surface as a dry one and hopes they begin well. With the short boundaries he hopes that they will adapt well to the dew coming in later.

MS Dhoni mentions that the groundsman has removed the grass so the pitch should slow down. Reckons that if there is dew they will have to be careful. Acknowledges that New Zealand are a dangerous side, they need to respect them. Ends by saying that no matter how you have done before in the series, you have to start well from scratch every game.

TOSS - INDIA WIN THE TOSS AND ELECT TO FIELD. No change for India from the previous game. Poor New Zealand have not won a single toss on this tour so far. Three changes for New Zealand - Trent Boult, Anton Devcich and Matt Henry come in for Jimmy Neesham, Ish Sodhi and Doug Bracewell.

Pitch Report - The ball will come on to the bat. Similar to Dharamsala but will only turn more. And with the dew factor coming in, captains will want to bowl first. Dhoni did that in Dharamsala and nothing different is to be expected today from whoever wins the toss. The plan will be, restrict them under 250 and chase the target under the lights, reckon Simon Doull and Sunil Gavaskar.

The Black Caps on the other hand, are in a slump right now. They've not exactly started the series off in the way they would have liked. Barring Tom Latham and Tim Southee, who was dropped, nobody really put up any kind of a fight. New Zealand's dismal performance with the bat didn't leave their bowlers with much of a chance. They'll be raring to turn things around today and get a win under their belt. Let's hope for a good contest.

Hello and welcome for the 2nd of this 5-match ODI series between India and New Zealand. We witnessed the hosts continuing their good form from the Test series as they bamboozled the Kiwis in the series opener. It was a collective performance from the entire bowling unit with everybody chipping in. They kept the pressure on and plucked wickets at will. Made it easier for their batsmen who finished it comfortably, with Virat Kohli leading the chase.
